git log --author=$E --format= --numstat | awk '{a+=$1;d+=$2} END{print a, d}'
{
echo "# Git contribution summary"
echo
echo "Generated $(date +%F) from the local repository history. Contains no source code, diffs or file contents."
echo
echo "- Identity: Jonathan Ong <$E> (the git identity configured in this repo)"
echo "- Total commits in repository: $(git rev-list --count HEAD) (all authors)"
echo "- Commits under this identity: $(git log --author=$E --oneline | wc -l) ($(git log --author=$E --no-merges --oneline | wc -l) regular, $(git log --author=$E --merges --oneline | wc -l) merges)"
echo "- Active period: $(git log --author=$E --format=%ad --date=short | tail -1) to $(git log --author=$E --format=%ad --date=short | head -1)"
echo "- Lines added/removed (regular commits): $(git log --author=$E --no-merges --format= --numstat | awk '{a+=$1;d+=$2} END{print "+"a" / -"d}')"

echo
echo "## Commits by year"
git log --author=$E --format=%ad --date=format:%Y | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print "- "$2": "$1" commits"}'
echo
echo "## Commit list"
echo
echo "| Date | Hash | Subject | Files | + | - |"
echo "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"
git log --author=$E --format='@@%ad|%h|%s' --date=short
